name: Frugalia
tagline: Agentic FinOps platform that detects, analyzes and resolves infrastructure waste in Kubernetes clusters.
problem: Kubernetes clusters accumulate idle and oversized resources that teams pay for without noticing.
solution: Agents built on kagent, kgateway and kmcp continuously find waste, explain it and act to resolve it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Practical and impactful: continuous cost optimization for real teams.
Strong submission package — the organizer called out the blog, the video and the repository.
Uses three of the organizer's own projects together, the deepest platform fit in its track.

lessons: For online open-source hackathons, the write-up and video are the demo — invest in them like a live pitch.
